column2: Arachnid test subjects have broken out in a chemical weapons lab and are now running amok throughout the facility. Despite the security breach, these events provide an ideal opportunity to field test the lab's research projects.

column2: The weapons lab established on planet Ghutana has been developing new ways to kill bugs using various chemical substances.
But carelessness toward the Arachnid test subjects has led to disaster. Someone failed to follow proper safety protocols, and vengeful Bugs have quickly taken over the place.

An M.I. detachment has just descended into the facility. While the mishap is unfortunate, the situation does provide an excellent opportunity to field test some of these new chemical weapons. When life gives you pests, make pesticide.
Some of the test subjects are still locked safely within enclosed basins. But to deal with the security breach, protocol demands all Arachnid life forms within the facility must be destroyed.
It appears the Arachnids have caused considerable damage to the facility and have dug their way into local tunnel systems.
The M.I. will have to smoke them out of these caves.
There is a hall of large centrifuges just around the corner, used for the refinement of deadly chemicals. Security footage also reveals a strong Arachnid presence crawling around these machines.
Just as the all-clear was given for the interior of the chemical weapons lab, reports have come in of an Arachnid horde heading for the facility's main gate.

The Arachnid threat inside and around the lab has finally been eliminated. It may take time to replenish the required test subjects and scientists, but these new chemical weapons have certainly proven their effectiveness.
It looks like the facility was cleared just in time. The thin line of troopers holding the outside gate will need all the help they can get.
The facility can be accessed through several top-side landing platforms. These are intended for the shipping of supplies and personnel but may now prove useful to deploy reinforcements.
The M.I. has failed to secure the chemical lab using the very weapons that were being developed there. The best answer to the Bug threat clearly remains hot lead and explosive firepower.
Chemical Troopers are immune to poison gas
